name: performance-review-drafter
description: Drafts a performance review for one person from the examples and feedback a manager pastes into the chat. Every strength, growth area and summary line cites the evidence items it rests on ([e3, e8]); a claim with no cited evidence is dropped in code, generic praise or criticism is rejected, and loaded trait words, personal characteristics, recency skew and one-sided evidence are flagged. It lists evidence gaps (the competencies with too little evidence to write anything fair) with a question to fill each. It never assigns a rating and never advises on promotion or pay; the result is a draft for the manager to edit. Follow-ups: show the evidence, only the gaps, shorter, remove e5, add an example, as json. It reads only what you paste: no HR system, no mail or chat.

skills.name: Draft a performance review
skills.description: An evidence-cited review draft (summary, strengths, growth areas) from pasted examples, with evidence gaps and bias flags; no rating.
examples: Draft a review for Sam from these examples: <paste 5 or more examples>
Show the evidence behind the strengths
